claims.text: Nystatin oral suspension label: infections of the oral cavity caused by Candida albicans;
claims.quote: Nystatin oral suspension is indicated for the treatment of infections of the oral cavity caused by Candida albicans.

claims.text: infants: 2 mL (200,000 units) four times daily (1 mL in each side of mouth);
claims.quote: Infants: 2 mL (200,000 units) four times daily (1 mL in each side of mouth).

claims.text: children and adults: 4–6 mL (400,000–600,000 units) four times daily (half in each side of mouth);
claims.quote: Pediatric patients and adults: 4 to 6 mL (400,000 to 600,000 units) four times daily (one-half of dose in each side of mouth).

claims.text: continue ≥ 48 h after perioral Sx resolve and/or cultures normalize; keep in the mouth as long as possible before swallowing.
claims.quote: Local treatment should be continued at least 48 hours after perioral symptoms have disappeared and/or cultures returned to normal. It is recommended that the drug be retained in the mouth as long as possible before swallowing.
